label.zh: 对剩下的生物实施安乐死。

label.en: Inject the liquid into the egg.

label.zh: 对剩下的生物实施安乐死。

texts.zh:
我们在一个废弃的研究设施内。

这个房间的表面覆盖着厚厚的灰尘，表明它已经有一段时间没有使用了。

我们无法找到任何研究人员，无论是活着与否。无论这个地方的看守者是谁，他们早已离开了。

墙壁上排列着重型架子，每个架子上都放着一枚大型蛋。它们中的大多数都处于不同的腐烂状态，但仍有一些活体标本。

在这个房间的中心有一个敞开的容器，里面装满了苍白的粘性液体。对液体的分析显示，它含有大量的蛋白质和氨基酸。从一些蛋上留下的残留物来看，我们推测这些液体是由研究人员注射的。
texts.en:
We are inside of an abandoned research facility.

The surfaces in this room are coated in a thick layer of dust, indicating it has not been in use for some time.

We can detect no researchers, living or otherwise. Whoever the caretakers of this place might have been, they are long since gone.

Heavy-duty shelves line the walls, each holding a large egg. Most of them are in various states of decay, but a few living specimens remain.

At the center of this chamber rests an open container filled with a pale, viscous liquid. An analysis of the fluid reveals that it contains high amounts of proteins and amino acids. Judging by the residue left on some of the eggs, we speculate this fluid was being injected by the researchers.

texts.zh:
我们砸开了蛋中看起来最健康的样本。

里面的胚胎看起来营养不良，并被外来寄生虫所覆盖。

值得注意的是，这些寄生虫拥有任何已知生物体所不曾拥有的独特的量子特性。它们在蛋壳内部随机传送，甚至可以传送到胚胎内部。鉴于该实验室中只剩下很少的活的蛋，这个特殊的标本必然对寄生虫的行为具有特别的抵抗力。

对这两种生物体的星界追踪表明，这些寄生虫起源于一个独特且遥远的维度。我们相信这种寄生虫是无意中被召唤到这里的，并中断了该设施的预期研究。

我们看到他们被这个房间中央的一桶奇怪液体所吸引。也许这就是吸引他们来到这里的首要原因。
texts.en:
We have opened the healthiest looking specimen among the eggs.

The embryo inside appeared malnourished and covered with foreign parasites.

Remarkably, the parasites possess quantum properties unique to any known biological organism. They warp randomly around the inside of the egg's casing, and presumably inside of the embryo itself. Given that so few living eggs remain in this laboratory, this particular specimen must be especially resistant to the parasite's behavior.

Astral tracing of both organisms indicate the parasites originated from a distinct and distant dimension. We believe this parasite was inadvertently summoned here, and has interrupted the intended research of this facility.

We have seen them drawn to the vat of strange liquid in the center of this chamber. Perhaps this is what attracted them here in the first place.

label.en: Inject the liquid into the egg.

label.zh: 对剩下的生物实施安乐死。

texts.zh:
我们已经找到了这个地方的看护者。更准确地说，我们已经找到了它们的残骸。

附近的一个房间里堆满了尸体。他们的四肢已经被某种未知的力量在原子层面上彻底地分开了。有些尸体半融合在墙内。

中央检查台上放着一堆大部分被解剖过的蛋。其中一枚完好无损。

将看护者的遗体带回进行适当的研究应该可以让我们对这里发生的事情有一些洞见。
texts.en:
We have found the caretakers of this place. More accurately, we have found what remains of them.

A nearby room is littered with corpses. Their limbs have been cleanly separated at the atomic level by some unknown force. Some of the carcasses are half-fused inside of the walls.

A clutch of mostly dissected eggs is present on a central examining table. One of remains intact.

Taking the caretakers' remains back for proper study should provide some insight into what happened here.

texts.zh:
将苍白液体注入暴露的胚胎中产生了一些有趣的结果。

尽管有量子寄生体，之前昏昏欲睡的样本已然重新焕发了活力。事实上，我们可能错误地计算了剂量。在很短的时间内，一个发育更完全的生物开始触碰蛋壳——蛋壳上覆盖着多层密布的装甲板和尖刺。

然而，寄生虫也受到刺激。当它们积极地传送进出胚胎时，该生物的组织就会受到损害。按照这个速度，它很可能会死亡。

我们推测，注入少量的星体丝缕可能会满足量子寄生虫并防止进一步的损害。
texts.en:
Injecting the pale liquid into the exposed embryo has produced some interesting results.

In spite of the quantum parasites, the previously lethargic specimen has become reinvigorated. In fact, we may have miscalculated the dose. In a very short period of time, a more developed creature began pushing at the walls of the egg - one covered in a lattice of overlapping armored plates and spines.

However, the parasites were also stimulated. As they energetically teleport in and out of the embryo, the creature's tissue is being damaged. At this rate, it will likely perish.

We speculate that injecting a small amount of astral thread may satisfy the quantum parasites and prevent further damage.

texts.zh:
这个生物没有康复的希望。感染它的蛋的寄生虫太危险了，不应该传播到这个裂隙之外。

按照严格的防污染流程，我们用盐酸对附近的所有标本进行了安乐死。我们将带着样品返回以供进一步研究。
texts.en:
This creature had no hope of recovery. The parasites infesting its egg are too dangerous to allow propagation beyond this rift.

Following strict anti-contamination procedures, we have euthanized all specimens in the vicinity with hydrochloric acid. We are returning with samples for further study.

label.zh: 高酸性又为这道菜肴增添了风味。
label.en: High acidity can add flavor to the dish.

texts.zh:
胚胎已经解体。

尽管我们努力稳定样本，但其体内的寄生虫很快将其随机地分裂开。

这种不稳定的量子感染一定破坏了这个实验室本来要进行的任何实验。

尽管如此，我们在这里的观察增进了我们对极其不稳定条件下的生物学的理解。
texts.en:
The embryo has disintegrated.

Despite our efforts to stabilize the specimen, the parasites in its body soon split it apart in random directions.

This volatile quantum infection must have disrupted whatever experiments were meant to be happening in this laboratory.

Nonetheless, our observations here have advanced our understanding of biology in extremely unstable conditions.

texts.zh:
胚胎已经解体。

果然，它体内的寄生体很快就将它朝着随机的方向分裂开来。

这种不稳定的量子感染一定破坏了这个实验室本来要进行的任何实验。

尽管如此，我们在这里的观察增进了我们对极其不稳定条件下的生物学的理解。
texts.en:
The embryo has disintegrated.

As expected, the parasites in its body soon split it apart in random directions.

This volatile quantum infection must have disrupted whatever experiments were meant to be happening in this laboratory.

Nonetheless, our observations here have advanced our understanding of biology in extremely unstable conditions.

texts.zh:
试验成功了。

我们向胚胎中注入的星界丝缕将量子寄生虫稳定住了。

发育完全的幼雏完好无损地破壳而出。它意外地具有服从性，而且很快地学会了基本的命令。基于这点，再加上它厚厚的盔甲般的皮毛和有毒的刺，我们推测这些生物是为了战斗而繁育的。

令人惊奇的是，它们还展现出了短距离曲速跃迁的能力。星界丝缕似乎把这些生物和寄生虫被编织成了某种特别的共生体。

我们可能创造出了某种特别危险的东西。

这个卑如蝼蚁的星系面对这些我们将释放出去的东西会有多么无助。
texts.en:
The experiment was a success.

The astral thread we have injected into the embryo has stabilized the quantum parasites.

The fully-developed hatchling has emerged intact. It is incredibly obedient and was quick to learn the most basic of commands. Based on that, as well as its thick, armored-hide and poisonous spines, we speculate that these creatures were being bred for war. 

Startlingly, it has demonstrated the ability to "warp" small distances. The astral thread seems to have woven a unique symbiotic relationship between the creature and the parasites.

We may have created something entirely too dangerous.

Our pathetic galaxy is not prepared for what we shall soon unleash upon them.

texts.zh:
我们已经完成了研究人员尸体的采集工作，并将其运回来作进一步研究。

他们身上长满了量子寄生虫，这些寄生虫具有任何已知生物有机体所不具有的特性。它们不可预测地“扭曲”物质的能力可能是导致宿主死亡的原因。

两种生物体的星界追踪表明寄生虫起明显源于一个的遥远的次元。我们认为这种寄生虫是无意中被召唤到这里的，它以一种毁灭性的方式中断了该设施的原定研究。

我们已用氢氯酸迅速消灭了害虫，以防止进一步污染。
texts.en:
We've completed the harvesting of the researcher's corpses and are transporting them back for further study.

They were covered with quantum parasites that possess properties unique to any known biological organism. Their ability to unpredictably 'warp' through matter is likely what resulted in the death of their hosts.

Astral tracing of both organisms indicate the parasites originated from a distinct and distant dimension. We believe this parasite was inadvertently summoned here, and has interrupted the intended research of this facility in a devastating fashion.

We have summarily neutralized the pests with hydrochloric acid to prevent further contamination.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]突然去世了。死因是暴露在来自[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]裂隙彼端的致命寄生虫。他的研究部门也被隔离，以待进一步的消杀。
texts.en: [From.GetName] was found dead. The cause was exposure to the deadly parasites beyond the rift in [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]. Their quarters are quarantined and awaiting full decontamination.
